burning.name: Burning
burning.description: Flames cling to you and sear every movement.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: You are on the ground and must spend a turn standing up.

staggered.name: Staggered
staggered.description: The impact leaves you off balance and unable to use special abilities.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.description: Dust and darkness blur everything beyond arm's reach.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.description: Webbing or bonds pin you in place and leave you unable to flee.

escape_action.label: Break Free
escape_action.success: You tear free of the bonds.
escape_action.failure: You struggle, but the bonds still hold.

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.description: A honeyed voice makes it hard to raise your hand against its owner.

escape_action.label: Resist the Charm
escape_action.success: You shake off the charming voice.
escape_action.failure: The charming voice tightens its hold.
